label: first-world
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: THREE separate tall portrait game backgrounds arranged as equal-width columns side by side, without gutters, frames or dividing rules. Each portrait is approximately 1:2.16, overall canvas approximately 3:2.16. Create full rectangular paintings, NOT icons. The supplied images are style/continuity references: luminous opaque gouache, selective fine ink, lapis, jade, burnt ochre, muted coral, warm ivory light. Monumental and intimate, a world being created, never a settlement. No text, numbers, words, ornamental borders, people unless explicitly specified, buildings, UI or watermark. Place dramatic landmarks mainly in the UPPER 42 percent of EACH portrait; the LOWER 58 percent must be a spacious calm medium-LIGHT desaturated blue-grey/ochre painted foreground with sparse broad atmospheric strokes, giving dark circular tokens readable working space. This calm area belongs naturally to each painting, not a rectangular UI panel or flat overlay. Preserve the three equal portrait panels. Recurring geography when visible: hooked ochre headland at upper left, a single arched cave at its foot when the requested era permits a cave, teal tidal inlet, pale dry rock shelf on the RIGHT inside the entrance and a broad dry upper interior wall above the tidal wash. The dry shelf is connected to exposed rock at the mouth, visibly above the water; do not flood the whole floor. Distant jagged coastal hills, pale Moon with a pair of adjacent unequal craters, consistent with reference. No actual Earth map. LEFT: A recently cooled bare rocky PLANET against deep sky, large in the upper third. Same brown hook-shaped non-Earth landform relief as the rocky-world reference token, thin cracked grey-ochre surface with only faint residual warm seams, no ocean, NO Moon, no vegetation. This world has not received its companion or sea yet. Lower half calm pale blue-grey cosmic pigment atmosphere. CENTER: The first vast OCEAN under the pale paired-crater Moon. Bare hooked ochre headland and solid unbroken cliff at upper left, calm immense turquoise sea, distant bare weathered rock and a narrow river mouth. NO cave or arch opening yet, no plants, no animals, no glaciers, no rainbow or aurora. Lower scene calm pale sea and sand. RIGHT: Deep underwater hydrothermal landscape BEFORE LIFE. Two dark mineral chimneys on an upper-left rocky ridge pour dark plumes upward through jade water; slanting light from a far distant upper surface conveys the whole water column symbolically. No algae, cells, fish, worms, coral or people. Lower scene spacious muted turquoise-grey water and simple mineral foreground, not dense bubbles.
